items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, forecast, requeue, experiment, duplicate telemetry, or production work. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned ledger for provider, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, and infrastructure costs matched to site-attributed revenue and experiment-level incremental outcomes, plus an owner-approved monthly limit. Do not treat impressions, clicks, conversions, SEO actions, technical scores, or aggregate commission as financial return.

Retain the existing measurement and reconciliation work without creating duplicate finance requests. Revenue claims remain unsupported beyond the one-day aggregate provider result; no forecast, margin, payback, or ROI claim is justified. Infrastructure and other operating costs remain unknown because no period-aligned ledger is present. Continue only existing work and preserve all unknowns.
